name: Eldritch Knight

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A warrior who adds Wizard spells, a bonded weapon and spell-and-strike combinations.

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.summary: Cast Wizard spells with Intelligence: two cantrips and three prepared spells to start.
feature.text: You learn two Wizard cantrips (three at level 10) and prepare level 1+ Wizard spells as shown in your Eldritch Knight table; whenever you gain a Fighter level you can swap one cantrip and one prepared spell. Your slots follow the Eldritch Knight table. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus can be your focus.

feature.name: War Bond
feature.summary: Bond with up to two weapons: you can't be disarmed of them and can summon one as a Bonus Action.
feature.text: Over a Short Rest you can bond with a weapon (up to two bonded weapons). You can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon unless you are Incapacitated, and if it is on the same plane you can summon it to your hand as a Bonus Action.

feature.name: War Magic
feature.summary: Replace one attack of your Attack action with a Wizard cantrip that takes an action.

feature.name: Eldritch Strike
feature.summary: A creature you hit with a weapon has Disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

feature.name: Arcane Charge
feature.summary: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30 feet.

feature.name: Improved War Magic
feature.summary: Replace two attacks with a level 1 or 2 Wizard spell that takes an action.
